mapper.select: SELECT id, toilet_code AS toiletCode, name, address, district, open_time AS openTime, created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_toilet ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_toilet (toilet_code, name, address, district, open_time, created_at) VALUES (#{toiletCode}, #{name}, #{address}, #{district}, #{openTime}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.toilet_id AS toiletId, t.name AS toiletName, f.facility_name AS facilityName, f.facility_type AS facilityType, f.status, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tb_facility f JOIN tb_toilet t ON t.id = f.toilet_id ORDER BY f.id DESC
SELECT id, toilet_id AS toiletId, facility_name AS facilityName, facility_type AS facilityType, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tb_facility WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.toilet_id AS toiletId, t.name AS toiletName, r.facility_id AS facilityId, f.facility_name AS facilityName, r.fault_desc AS faultDesc, r.reporter, r.reporter_name AS reporterName, r.assignee_name AS assigneeName, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_repair_order r JOIN tb_toilet t ON t.id = r.toilet_id LEFT JOIN tb_facility f ON f.id = r.facility_id ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, toilet_id AS toiletId, facility_id AS facilityId, fault_desc AS faultDesc, reporter, reporter_name AS reporterName, assignee_name AS assigneeName, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_repair_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_repair_order (order_no, toilet_id, facility_id, fault_desc, reporter, reporter_name, assignee_name, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{toiletId}, #{facilityId}, #{faultDesc}, #{reporter}, #{reporterName}, #{assigneeName}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.toilet_id AS toiletId, t.name AS toiletName, c.consumable_name AS consumableName, c.current_stock AS currentStock, c.min_stock AS minStock, CASE WHEN c.current_stock < c.min_stock THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lowStock FROM tb_consumable_stock c JOIN tb_toilet t ON t.id = c.toilet_id ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT id, receiver_name AS receiverName, title, content, read_flag AS readFlag, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tb_message ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_message (receiver_name, title, content, read_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{receiverName}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_toilet) AS toiletCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM toilet_feedback) AS feedbackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_repair_order WHERE status NOT IN ('FINISHED', 'CANCELED')) AS repairPendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_consumable_stock WHERE current_stock < min_stock) AS lowStockCount
